chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ayoub ibn Nuh, or one of his companions, from Ayoub, from Safwan ibn Yahya, who said: 'One of our companions narrated to me, saying:'

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'When four (things) become prevalent, four (things) would appear. When adultery becomes prevalent, earthquakes appear; and when tyranny in judgment becomes prevalent, the raindrops are withheld; and when the covenant (of protection) is breached, polytheists are given preference over the people of Islam; and when Zakat is withheld, need (poverty/hardship) appears.'

key_terms.خُفِرَتِ الذِّمَّةُ: The covenant of protection was breached

ai.seo_question: What are the four sins and their corresponding divine consequences according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the cosmic and social repercussions of four key sins, reflecting the Shia scholarly understanding of how moral decay in society triggers tangible divine punishments. It specifically links the prevalence of adultery to seismic disturbances, judicial injustice to drought, the breach of covenant with non-Muslims (Ahl al-Dhimmah) to political subversion, and the withholding of Zakat to economic scarcity. These connections underscore the holistic view of cause and effect in Islamic theology, where spiritual integrity directly influences physical and societal stability.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, or one of his companions, from Ayoub, from Safwan Bin Yahya who said, ‘One of our companions narrated to me saying,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘When four (things) become prevalent, four (things) would appear. When the adultery is prevalent the earthquakes would appear, and when the tyranny is prevalent in the judgments, the drops (of rain) would be Withheld, and when the non-Muslim taxpayers (Zimmy) are unprotected, the people of Polytheism would be more just than the people of Al-Islam, and when the Zakāt is prevented, the need would appear’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh or certain individuals of his people from Ayyub from Safwan ibn Yahya who has said that certain individuals of our people has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘When four things spread four other things appear: When fornication spreads all over, earthquakes turn out to be apparent. When injustice in governing is widespread, drops (of rain are) held back, when the rights of al-Dhimmah taxpayers are ignored, the pagans dominate the followers of Islam and when payment of al-Zakat (charity) is held back poverty spreads all over.’”
